items.text: Details of any literature or other material relied on
A statement of the substance of all material instructions (written or oral)
Which facts and matters are within the expert's own knowledge
Who carried out any examination, measurement or test, their qualifications, and whether supervised
Where there is a range of opinion, a summary of the range and reasons for the expert's own opinion
A summary of the conclusions reached
If an opinion is qualified, a statement of the qualification
A statement that the expert understands and has complied with their duty to the court, is aware of PD35 and the Guidance, and a statement of truth

declarations.text:
I confirm that I have made clear which facts and matters referred to in this report are within my own knowledge and which are not. Those that are within my own knowledge I confirm to be true. The opinions I have expressed represent my true and complete professional opinions on the matters to which they refer.

I understand that proceedings for contempt of court may be brought against anyone who makes, or causes to be made, a false statement in a document verified by a statement of truth without an honest belief in its truth.

deviations: The case bar's subtitle: the board shows a case description and trial month; the API has neither, the page shows the case type and due date (artboardCss).
Gap: the board's first hearing line ends 'you're expected on day 2' (no data on which day the expert attends) and the court is a placeholder '[COURT]'; the artboard is rendered without the day.

Gap: the order card's third line ('We suggested the dates it sets. You confirmed them on 21 January.') has no data (the order does not say which dates were suggested or confirmed); it is hidden on the artboard. The page lists 'Dates it set' when the order created some.

Gap: the history's 'Why' says the kind of reason ('A court order', 'An agreement with the other side'); the board names the order's date or the agreement ('Order of 20 January', 'Extension agreed by email, 16 December'), which the change record does not hold. Deadline names are the pack's words; the artboard is rendered with the page's wording (artboardCss).

The board has no 'Add a hearing' link or 'Move this date' list; the page keeps both so those jobs can still be done: 'Add a hearing' sits at the right of the Hearings heading, and the dates disclosure moves below the hold block (the board's last section).
Straight quote marks around the order's words, as the board; text the board sets at 14 to 16px is 17px; the Pause/withdraw and Rebuild buttons keep 52px hit areas with negative margins.
